amide_definition: Unique C(=O)-N matches of RDKit SMARTS [CX3](=[OX1])[NX3] on the frozen standardized_isomeric_smiles; operational amide motif count, not a validated peptide classifier
descriptor_definition: Use existing frozen physicochemical_descriptors_json for MW/TPSA. Compute amide motif count only; do not rerun standardizer or model.
Biogen_unit: identity_audited_v2 analysis rows; identity_clean=yes and model_usable=yes; unique connectivity; remove development reference exact/connectivity overlap
ASAP_unit: existing posthoc 56-compound median-log2ER aggregation, joined to existing 62 frozen prediction rows by standardized key; remove development reference exact/connectivity overlap
ADC_unit: existing 14 frozen source-resolved species_predictions; coverage mapping only; no ER labels supplied or inferred
development_reference_sets: 443 weak-label training audited keys and 84 identity-audited direct reference panel keys; conservative source-key connectivity check reported separately
label_boundary: ER >= 2 is an assay-specific weak measured endpoint; general-molecule negatives are not ADC negatives
ASAP_aggregation_boundary: Known post-outcome secondary sensitivity aggregation; actual vial/lot and biological independence are not established
cross_source_identity: Reported, not pooled or treated as independent additional measurements
gate_purpose: Count-only advice for a limited retrospective same-count comparison; never a validated ADC domain or confirmatory statistical adequacy claim
